method: Independent reconstruction from anonymous publicly observable behaviour. REA evidence separates observed page content, static inferences and unknown internals.
publication_scope: Summaries, provenance and receipt digests only. Raw site DOM, screenshots, third-party scripts, network logs and browser profiles are not included.
observations: The public feature catalogue describes editable CV structure, content and visual styling, document feedback, role tailoring and a job application tracker.
The anonymous application redirects to a four-step onboarding flow. Its initial step offers an existing CV as a starting point or starting without one; login is available separately.
implementation_choices: Use an independently designed CV document model, section controls, print/export layouts, local persistence and transparent deterministic keyword feedback.
unknowns: Authenticated editor state transitions, service APIs, proprietary template designs, checker scoring and AI implementations have not been recovered.
The public catalogue advertises capabilities; it does not prove their internal behaviour or effectiveness.
The passive CDP application inspection did not finish within the investigation window and was stopped. No successful EnhanceCV static bundle analysis is claimed.
